The Fox and the Crow

A vain crow sits proudly with a piece of cheese. A sly, clever fox flatters her and she is very pleased with herself. When she sings, she drops the cheese, and the fox runs off with it. The crow is ashamed and sad.
Hansel and Gretel

Hansel and Gretel are a kind brother and sister who love each other. Their cruel stepmother sends them into the forest. A wicked witch catches them and keeps them apart. Gretel is brave and pushes the witch away, and the children run home together, very happy.
The Ugly Duckling

A shy, ugly duckling is teased and pushed around by the other ducks, and is very unhappy. He is lonely all winter. In the spring he finds the swans, who are kind and welcome him, and he is happy and proud.
Snow White

Snow White is beautiful, good and kind. The queen is beautiful but vain and evil, and hates her. The queen chases Snow White into the forest. The kind dwarfs protect her, and in the end a prince comes and they are happy together.
Jack and the Beanstalk
Jack is a poor, curious, brave boy. A huge, mean giant hates Jack and chases him. Jack is quick and gets away, and the giant is angry. Jack and his mother are happy at the end.
The Three Little Pigs

Three cheerful little pigs are friends. A big, mean wolf wants to catch them and chases them from house to house. The pigs stay together and keep the wolf out, and the wolf goes away angry. The pigs are happy and proud.
Goldilocks and the Three Bears

Goldilocks is a curious, rude girl. Three bears, a big father, a kind mother and a small shy baby, come home and find her. The father bear is angry and chases her away. The baby bear is sad, and Goldilocks is frightened.
The Boy Who Cried Wolf

A bored, playful shepherd boy tricks the villagers again and again, and they are annoyed. When a real, hungry wolf comes, the boy is frightened and nobody comes to help. The wolf chases the sheep and the boy is very sad.
The Lion and the Mouse
A big, strong, proud lion catches a tiny, timid mouse but lets her go. Later the lion is trapped and unhappy. The mouse is brave and helps him get free, and they become friends, both very happy.
The Gingerbread Man
A cheeky, fast gingerbread man runs away from everyone, and they chase him. He is very pleased with himself. A sly fox pretends to be his friend, and in the end the fox catches him.
Romeo and Juliet

Romeo and Juliet are young, beautiful and in love. Their families hate each other and keep them apart, and they are very unhappy. Tybalt is angry and fights Romeo. In the end the lovers are together, but very sad.
The Tortoise and the Hare, again

A fast, boastful hare makes fun of a slow, hard-working tortoise. They race. The hare is lazy and falls asleep, and the determined tortoise keeps going and wins. The tortoise is proud and happy, and the hare is ashamed.
